Version 1.0
Terms of use & data notice

This app holds confidential site records belonging to ITK and its client. It is for authorised personnel only.

What is recorded. Your checklist answers, remarks and snags; photographs you take in the app, stamped with date, time, site and GPS where the device allows it; asset tags; the names and signatures on the Sign-off screen; and the time and result of every submission with the account that made it. Location is stamped on photographs only — the app never tracks you in the background.

Where it goes. The handover is saved on this phone so nothing is lost without signal, then sent as a PDF to the administrator and filed in the company site register. It is used as evidence of completion, for snag tracking, audit, invoicing and client reporting.

Your obligations. Credentials are personal — never shared. Photographs must be taken at the site during the inspection; a false record is a disciplinary matter and may be recovered as a loss. Nothing from this app — least of all photographs — may be forwarded outside the company. This phone must have a screen lock; report loss or theft the same day.

Safety. This app records work, it does not authorise it. Hold the required permits and follow every isolation, height, generator and fuel rule. Do not use the app while driving or climbing.

The app is provided as is, with no warranty of availability, GPS accuracy or tag recognition. Records are kept for the retention period set by the company. Governed by the laws of the State of Kuwait.

The full terms are issued with the app as a separate document. Accepting records the version, your account and the date.
Not accepting means the app cannot be used.

Before you start
Who is using this phone?

There is no password. Your name goes onto every handover you file, so the office knows whose work it is, and the sites in your own governorates are listed first. Choose yourself from the list; if the phone passes to somebody else, change it in Settings.

Choose a name above
Before you start
Allow camera & on-device storage
Camera — for stamped site photos and for reading asset tags. Location is stamped onto each photo.
Device storage — every answer, photograph and signature is written into this phone's own storage as you work. A call, a restart or a flat battery costs you nothing. The app asks the phone to keep that storage permanently; nothing is sent anywhere until you press Submit.
